is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae s.s. (M and S molecular forms) entering experimental huts in Vallée du Kou (page 1, Abstract; page 2, Methods).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Detection of kdr alleles using the PCR method of Martinez-Torres et al. 1998 (Vgsc L995F / L1014F) (page 3, 'Genetic information').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 gives exact counts of mosquitoes genotyped and dead/total collected for each kdr genotype (kdr/kdr, kdr/+, +/+) across M and S forms and experimental hut arms, totaling 202 specimens (page 4, Table 2 and text under 'Impact of kdr mutation on mortality').

african_field_population.evidence: Field mosquitoes collected entering experimental huts in Vallée du Kou near Bobo-Dioulasso, Burkina Faso (page 2, 'Study area' and page 3, 'Results').

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary experimental hut trial conducted between mid-September and late December 2005 (page 3, 'Methods').

sub_country_location.evidence: Vallée du Kou, near Bobo-Dioulasso, Burkina Faso (page 2, 'Study area').

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Evaluated over 80 nights between mid September and late December 2005 (page 3, 'Methods').

duplicate_risk.evidence: Standard experimental hut trial conducted by IRD/IRSS/Centre Muraz teams in 2005 with no indication of sample sharing from external databases.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype and genotype-phenotype mortality data are fully presented in Table 2 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated permethrin-treated durable lining (ITPS) alone and in combination with Olyset long-lasting insecticidal nets in experimental huts in Vallée du Kou, Burkina Faso in 2005. A sample of 202 An. gambiae s.s. (M and S molecular forms) collected from the huts were genotyped for the Vgsc L995F kdr mutation, with genotype frequencies and mortality breakdowns provided for each treatment arm.
